name: shadPS4 guest user area reservation at USER_MIN, Apple/x86-64 workaround already applied (USER_MIN=0x7000000000, USER_MAX=0x5FFFFFFFFFFF)
required_postconditions: the guest user area occupies exactly [USER_MIN, USER_MAX] with no host object inside it
USER_MIN is raised above the band shadPS4's own comment describes as GPU-reserved, so the reservation must start at or after 0x7000000000

failure_sink.description: identical sink to the non-Apple variant: MAP_FAILED is tested at lines 677-678 and the constructor executes `throw std::bad_alloc{}` at line 680. On this path the user area gets its own mmap at line 654-655 rather than being carved out of one combined reservation, because the Apple layout has two holes in it (see the comment at lines 645-647).

source_locations.symbol: comment: "GPU-reserved memory ranges from 0x1000000000 - 0x6FFFFFFFFF, so increase the user minimum." (this is shadPS4's own comment, not a verified platform fact)
Core::USER_MAX (neither __linux__ nor __FreeBSD__, so macOS takes this branch: 0x5FFFFFFFFFFFULL)
.zerofill USER_AREA,...,0x5F9000000000 - Apple-only directive that independently confirms the computed size
Impl::Impl - dedicated mmap(USER_MIN, user_size, ..., MAP_FIXED) on the Apple/x86-64 path

MemoryManager::IsValidGpuMapping - max_gpu_address = 0x10000000000; raising USER_MIN to 0x7000000000 shrinks the GPU-addressable slice of the user area from 0xF000000000 (960 GiB) to 0x9000000000 (576 GiB)
